title: Morvali Creek Matsya Sahakari Sangh v. Tarangi Sugars Pvt. Ltd. and others (synthetic)
description: Synthetic matter for testing Aranya. Fishers' cooperative (214 members) against a 6,500 TCD sugar mill over effluent discharged to Morvali Creek in breach of a zero-liquid-discharge EC condition. Forum set to the NGT for the discharge, closure, compensation and restitution claims only: the EC challenge and the Wild Life Act heads do not fit in the same original application (see case-analysis.md).

parties.applicant: Morvali Creek Matsya Sahakari Sangh, Rasulgarh Taluka, State of Suvarnadesh
respondents: State Environment Impact Assessment Authority, Suvarnadesh

dates.first_recorded_discharge: last week of September 2024, per the Sangh's letter of 2024-10-09
